title: PostgreSQL: a slot the pipeline named stays after the pipeline is deleted

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: PostgreSQL 16.15, two pipelines

symptom: The dbx_ slot named by the pipeline was still listed 6 minutes after the delete (314 s for the second pipeline, polled every 20 s).
cause: Not isolated. The slot names were set by a pipeline update, since create requires a slot name.
effect: The orphaned slot keeps WAL from being removed.
fix: Drop the slot by hand after the delete (pg_drop_replication_slot).
notes: Whether the cleanup handles slots the gateway created itself wasn't tested.
